## What changes

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue; use `Closes #N` only when its acceptance criteria are met.

## Verification

Record the commands or actual interface/device checks, tested devices and observed results. Separate passed, failed, skipped and not-run checks. State whether real Apple model inference executed.

## Remaining gaps

List any unverified behavior, prerequisite or follow-up. Share reviewed evidence only; keep raw personal data and credentials local.
